card: Adjusts the -rpcwaittimeout test assertion in interface_bitcoin_cli.py to permit 0.1 seconds of timing slack and lowers the timeout duration from 5 seconds to 1 second. The previous strict equality check flaked under Docker CI load when process execution returned approximately 40 milliseconds early. This avoids spurious CI failures while speeding up the test execution.
changed_since_previous: Switched from a 0.5-second slack on a 5-second timeout to a 0.1-second slack on a 1-second timeout, shortening the overall test runtime.
evidence: Under Docker CI load the process can return a few tens of milliseconds early (~40ms observed), so the floor assert flakes (PR description).
problem: Under Docker CI load, `bitcoin-cli` can exit a few tens of milliseconds earlier than the strict wall-clock timeout assertion expects, causing spurious test failures.

risk.why: Touches only functional test timeout assertions and does not alter node or client production behavior.

summary: Adjusts the `-rpcwaittimeout` test assertion in `interface_bitcoin_cli.py` to allow 0.1 seconds of scheduling slack and lowers the test timeout from 5 seconds to 1 second. The assertion verifies that `bitcoin-cli -rpcwait` waits the expected duration before timing out when connecting to a stopped node.
